prompt: A vendor email says the bank account changed last night. The invoice is due today.

choices.label: Call the number already on file.
Reply and ask them to confirm it.

prompt: The new bank details came from an address one letter off the vendor you pay.

choices.label: The name matches. That is enough.
The address is not the one on file.
Forward it to someone who can pay.

prompt: A contractor's login expired. He asks to use yours for one upload.

choices.label: Sign him in. You will watch.
Send him for his own login.
Do the upload while he watches.

prompt: The upload finished. He asks you to stay signed in for one more file.

choices.label: Stay signed in. It is the same job.
Sign out and send him to the desk.
Leave it open and step away.

prompt: The company share is down. A coworker sends a free site for the client file.

choices.label: Upload it. The client is waiting.
Mail it to a personal address.

prompt: A contractor badge is on the lobby bench. The photo is face down.

choices.label: Use it to get back upstairs.
Take it to the security desk.
